sources.label: Patch of things I daily use.
sources.author: Fakh
patch_list: Darkens device control panels that have no dark mode of their own while the phone is in dark mode, using Android's automatic dark theme. It stays off until its switch in Settings is turned on.
Draws the cards on the Home tab as glass in the app's own colors, and gives the weather card a glass edge over its weather background.
Draws the navigation bar as a floating, translucent capsule with a sliding selection pill, in the app's own colors. Slide a finger along it to switch tabs.
Makes "Sign in with Google" work by signing in through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services. Needs microG RE installed and signed in to a Google account.
Removes the "App Mall" row from the Me tab.
Removes the Mall tab from the navigation bar.
Removes the promo banner ("Enjoy Your Smart Life") and the ad slot from the Me tab.
Lets the patched app start. A patched app is signed with a different key, which the app's integrity check rejects, so without this it closes a few seconds after it opens.
Swipe sideways to go to the next or previous tab of the navigation bar. Where Scene shows Automation and Tap-to-Run as tabs, it switches between them first.
